Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National CEO of St John’s Hospital and Fertility Centre named Female CEO of the Year 2026 at Ghana CEO Vision & Awards Source : Myjoyonline 2 November 2026 2:45pm Audio By Carbonatix
Dr (Mrs) Maame Yaa Afriye, Chief Executive Officer of St John’s Hospital and Fertility Centre, has been named Female CEO of the Year 2026 at the fifth edition of the Ghana CEO Vision & Awards.
The awards ceremony was held at the Kempinski Gold Coast Hotel in Accra on October 31, 2026, bringing together business leaders, industry stakeholders and other distinguished guests.
The Minister for Tourism, Culture and Creative Arts, Abla Dzifa Gomashie, was among the dignitaries who attended the event.
Dr Afriye received the award in recognition of her leadership and contributions to healthcare delivery and fertility services in Ghana.
According to the event organisers, the recognition reflects her commitment to advancing quality healthcare and her role in leading St John’s Hospital and Fertility Centre.
The Ghana CEO Vision & Awards celebrates leadership, innovation and excellence across Ghana’s corporate sector. Its fifth edition continued the initiative’s focus on recognising chief executives who demonstrate the values of staying relevant, staying connected, staying ahead of the game and getting verified.
St John’s Hospital and Fertility Centre provides medical and fertility services in Ghana under the leadership of Dr Afriye.
St. John’s Hospital & Fertility Centre is a private medical and reproductive health facility located at Tantra Hill Junction (near the Goil Service Station) in the Ga North Municipality of Accra.
Founded in November 2012, the centre focuses primarily on women's health, obstetrics, paediatrics, and fertility care.
